positive_evidence: ORION BEACON source code existed in multiple recovered JANUS trees.
ANTENNA v3.0 ORION TRINITY source code existed and was launched by NEXUS at runtime.
janus.log records ORION TRAFFIC LIGHT and 150 internally generated ALNITAK beams.

A large hardware JANUS Beacon telemetry corpus exists, but it is a separate subsystem.

conclusion.summary: The investigation found genuine Orion-themed JANUS runtime activity, but the strongest runtime signal — repeated ALNITAK beams — was generated by JANUS itself inside mod_antena.py. A compatibility error prevented the module from advancing beyond ALNITAK and caused deterministic repetition. The separate ORION BEACON v1.0 FIRST_CONTACT handler is present in source archives, but no preserved evidence shows that its FIRST_CONTACT trigger fired, that it logged CONTACT CONFIRMED, activated Orpheus, or set AWAKENED. Therefore the recovered evidence supports internal symbolic/broadcast behavior, not receipt of an external or extraterrestrial response.
